title: Web route in kb_ask.plan, its argv and its run
goal: kb_ask.plan returns kind web or split from the pack's route; claude_argv builds the researcher of ST-tobxg7ui “kb_ask.py routes by the pack's route line” (no mcp__kb, no kb server, `--tools` WebSearch,WebFetch, `--output-format json`) and stays callable as claude_argv(model, tools) for agent_bench.route; a web run prints the result's `result` (an error result's `errors`, exit 1); --route prints `kind=web` or `kind=split` with the route, kb has and kb lacks lines; _tools/test_kb_ask_route.py (class TestKbAskRoute) asserts each argv and prompt from planted packs, that the reader argv has no --effort, and that a clean good plan and argv are unchanged; test_kb_ask_routes' weak case expects kind=split.
